fieldwork_metadata.business_type: Men & Unisex Grooming Salon / Barber Shop
fieldwork_metadata.location: Shop 14, Main Market, Model Town, Jalandhar
fieldwork_metadata.study_objective: Capture genuine customer conversation logs, call frequency, pain points, booking behavior, and cancellation patterns to inform chatbot intent modeling.

key_findings_and_pain_points.issue: Interrupted Haircuts from Repetitive Phone Calls
key_findings_and_pain_points.details: Barbers have to stop holding clippers/scissors to answer the phone 25-40 times daily. 80% of these calls only ask 'Are you open?', 'How much for haircut?', or 'Is Vikram free right now?'.
key_findings_and_pain_points.impact: Slows down service, irritates customer in chair, risks uneven styling cuts.

key_findings_and_pain_points.issue: Lost Revenue After Hours (8:30 PM - 9:30 AM)
key_findings_and_pain_points.details: Customers often decide to groom late at night or early morning before work. Phone calls go unanswered, causing potential clients to walk into competing shops.
key_findings_and_pain_points.impact: Estimated 15-20 missed bookings per week (~₹6,000 - ₹9,000 weekly loss).

key_findings_and_pain_points.details: Bookings taken verbally over WhatsApp or phone during a haircut are frequently forgotten or entered incorrectly on a physical paper register.
key_findings_and_pain_points.impact: Double booked slots, customer frustration, awkward waiting times.

key_findings_and_pain_points.details: If a haircut is cut too short or scalp irritation occurs, customers rarely complain in person; they leave bad Google Reviews instead. There was no quiet complaint capture channel.
key_findings_and_pain_points.impact: Loss of repeat customers without knowing root causes.

customer_query_log_sample.query: what time do you close tonight?
fade cut ka kitna lete ho?
how much does beard shaping cost?
can I book Vikram today at 5pm for haircut and beard?
vikram bhai free hai kya 6 baje?
kal subah 10 baje ka slot mil sakta hai?
i need to cancel my booking for 4pm today
do i need an appointment or can i just walk in?
last time Rahul cut my hair too short, i am unhappy
do you accept Google Pay or Paytm?
can you treat severe scalp fungus and alopecia?

must_haves: Must take appointments into a calendar without requiring owner intervention.
Must clearly show prices so clients don't argue at the counter.
Must allow client to pick their preferred barber.
Must allow human escalation when a customer is angry or asks something custom.

owner_review_feedback.verdict: If the chatbot can run on Telegram and our counter tablet, it solves our biggest daily headache of stopping haircuts to answer basic questions.
